title: Wave 3 owner decisions
intro: Waves 0 to 3 are merged except 6B. Five other items were settled without you (listed in the notes file). Three need your call.

decisions.title: Draft report schemas and merge.json
decisions.ref: factory/schemas/*.schema.json; module 5, Draft report schemas; module 13
decisions.context: The spec gave no fields for stage-report, test-report, source-notes and review-findings, so wave 3 shipped drafts marked x-status: draft. merge.json (module 13) has no schema and is written as auto, reason and rules[{rule, passed, detail}]. The bug-fix gates run on these today. A finding of medium or high severity blocks, which matches review_findings_at_or_above: medium in module 13.

options.name: Accept the drafts as the phase 1 schemas
pros: bug-fix runs now with no change
The shapes are the smallest the skills and gates need
Changing a field later is a schema edit plus tests
cons: Real model output may not fit; there has been no live run
Each draft's x-status and DRAFT text must be removed by hand

options.name: Keep them as drafts until the first live run, then freeze
pros: Fields come from real artifacts, not guesses
cons: The drafts stay unsettled during the tutorial test
Needs a live run, which needs 6B and 16

options.name: Accept the drafts and also write a merge schema now
pros: merge.json is validated like every other state file
The dashboard can reject a bad merge.json
cons: Fixes the guessed merge.json fields into a schema before module 15 reads them for real
More files to keep in sync with module 13

decisions.why: The drafts are the smallest shape that makes bug-fix run, and a live run will show whether any field is wrong.

decisions.title: Loop count on bug-fix verify to fix
decisions.context: max is the number of loops allowed. bug-fix ships verify->fix with max: 2, so the third failure blocks. The module 8 walkthrough and its sample feedback record say loop 1 of 3 and block on the fourth failure. The code and a test follow the shipped file.

options.name: Keep max: 2 and change the walkthrough to 2
pros: The test pinning the shipped values stays true
Fewer wasted worker runs before a human is asked
cons: Two tries may be too few for a flaky e2e test
Changes a decided example in module 8

options.name: Raise the shipped file to max: 3 to match the walkthrough
pros: The doc and the shipped value agree
One more chance to fix a failing verify
cons: Changes behavior you did not choose
More worker cost on a stuck run

decisions.why: The shipped value is the one the tests pin, and an example in a walkthrough is the easier thing to change.

decisions.title: Phase 2 evals on main (PRs #39 and #40)
decisions.context: Another session merged two phase 2 PRs to main: #39 (docs/research/p2-9 trial, scripts/evals/reviewers) and #40 (factory/workflows/reviewer-eval.yaml, a test, an ADR). AGENTS.md says do not build phase 2 in phase 1. #40 puts reviewer-eval into the kit that gets copied to other repos, and adds a test to the engine suite.

options.name: Keep #39, and move reviewer-eval.yaml out of the shipped kit
pros: Keeps the eval research and scripts
The kit copied into other repos has no eval workflow
cons: A follow-up PR is needed, including the test
The other session's tests may expect the workflow in factory/workflows

options.name: Keep both as merged
pros: The eval workflow is already tested
cons: Breaks the phase 1 rule in AGENTS.md
The eval workflow ships to every repo that runs factory init

options.name: Revert #39 and #40
cons: Loses research someone did on purpose
Reverting a merged PR from another session needs that session's owner to agree

decisions.why: The research and scripts are outside the kit and harmless, while a workflow in the kit reaches other repos.
